title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Due-Date Change Limits by Tier
content:
**Account maintenance limits, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A change of the monthly due date on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract is measured against the tier figures below.

| Tier | Lifetime maximum due-date changes | Installments satisfied before a change | Max calendar days the first installment on the new due day may fall after the current next due date | Earliest due day | Latest due day | Minimum calendar months between two changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 1 | 6 | 15 | 1 | 28 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 1 | 6 | 15 | 1 | 28 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 2 | 3 | 20 | 1 | 28 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 2 | 3 | 20 | 1 | 28 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 3 | 3 | 25 | 1 | 28 | 12 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 3 | 1 | 25 | 1 | 28 | 12 |

## Reading the limits

- The new due day must be a day of the month from the 1st through the 28th, both included; the 29th, 30th and 31st are never due days.
- The lifetime maximum is a ceiling the changes already used must stay below: a Tier 3 contract that has used 1 change is below its maximum of 2; one that has used 2 is not.
- The installments-satisfied figure is a minimum: a Tier 1+ contract that has satisfied 1 installment meets it.
- The shift limit counts calendar days from the current next due date to the first installment on the new due day: on Tier 5 and Tier 4 that gap may be up to and including 15 days, on Tier 3 and Tier 2 up to 20, on Tier 1 and Tier 1+ up to 25.
